faqs.question: What does 🧭🗺️ mean?
faqs.answer: 🧭🗺️ is a travel-coded combo. The two emojis pair to set a journey-coded scene — arrival, departure, on the ground — more vividly than a single emoji could.

faqs.question: Is 🧭🗺️ a flex?
faqs.answer: Sometimes. Travel-coded combos can read performative when paired with a luxury-coded partner emoji. Watch the lead-up.

faqs.question: What does 🧭🗺️ mean at the airport?
faqs.answer: At the airport 🧭🗺️ punctuates departures and arrivals. The combo lands in travel-day threads across platforms.

faqs.question: Is 🧭🗺️ ever sarcastic?
faqs.answer: 🧭🗺️ is rarely sarcastic. The travel-coded register is sincere by default; reach for sarcasm-coded combos when irony is the point.
